randomness_semantics: Deterministic procedural integer hash with fixed uint32 seed and 24-bit fraction output; not proven independent, uniform, cryptographically secure, or physically calibrated.

visual_encoding.position: white two-dimensional dimensionless Cartesian display; grid and curve coordinates vary by lesson
visual_encoding.glyphs: blue dots, thin grid lines, orientation tiles, curves or isolines
visual_encoding.time: display parameter only; no infrastructure simulation or physical time
visual_encoding.color: #87CEFA secondary lines and #00BFFF or blue primary geometry; white canvas

alt_text: An eight by eight labeled white grid contains deterministic blue diagonal glyphs; no measured field, hazard, infrastructure or causal topology is encoded.
limits: Interactive WebGL2 renderer not independently tested across devices and browsers
GLSL integer/float arithmetic and antialiasing may vary by GPU
Deterministic hashes are not a validated stochastic model
Smooth interpolation does not establish empirical spatial covariance
Only the orientation-tile static example has a committed SVG fallback
Output cannot be used as uncertainty or sustainability/resilience evidence without separate modeling, data and validation
